content:
Central Approach to Enterprise AI Procurement

Anthropic has launched the new e-commerce platform Claude Marketplace, which makes it easier for businesses to purchase third-party software using Claude infrastructure. The platform, which is in limited preview, aims to simplify the software procurement process and consolidate enterprise AI spending in a single center.

Thanks to the new marketplace, companies will be able to run the entire process through Anthropic instead of managing invoices from multiple cloud services and different providers. Part of Anthropic spending commitments made at the enterprise level can be used to fund third-party tools. While distribution and shared-spending billing will be managed by Anthropic, the company will not take any commission from these transactions.

Technology Partners in the Initial Catalog

Claude Marketplace hosts only products that have integrated the company’s large language models into their services. The initial catalog includes major platforms focused on different areas of expertise:

  • Snowflake and GitLab: The largest industry players offering Claude-powered solutions for data management, cloud infrastructure, and DevOps processes.
  • Replit and Lovable: While Replit provides a coding environment for technical users with its natural language interface; Lovable enables employees without technical knowledge to build applications with prompts.
  • Harvey and Rogo: While Harvey offers AI automation for legal processes and contract drafts; Rogo provides tools for investment professionals for financial data analysis.

Following the app directory move that OpenAI recently launched for ChatGPT, Claude Marketplace aims to increase Anthropic’s competitiveness in the enterprise AI ecosystem and strengthen platform dependence for developers.
